title: Fixed Slotted Deck and Stepped Catch Basin Soap Dish
description: One newly authored complete empty static soap-dish exterior. A whole low rectangular catch basin has a finite full bottom, four thick perimeter walls and an integral lower inset ledge around a real shallow cavity. A separate complete rectangular deck with six genuine long through-slots rests on the whole ledge, with a narrow real perimeter clearance below the basin rim. Four complete short underside feet support the basin. All numerical geometry new, not a counting tray with its channel removed, a pet basin detached from its bottle base or a street drain cover shrunk. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up and whole bounds-centred ground datum. One original model zero scenes. Empty fixed artistic geometry only: no soap, liquid, drain flow, drying, drainage capacity, hygiene, chemical compatibility, easy removal, load, manufacture or safety capability. No rigging animation or interaction.
